info.name: MetroMatrix — Chunk 2 (Shopping)
info.description:
Browse → cart → preview → 2-store checkout (COD + transfer) → store lifecycle → transfer reject/resubmit → return → review → store catalogue tools → admin.

Needs: migrated DB, `npm run seed:superadmin`, `npm run seed:shopping` (SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD), Mailpit. Run with `npm run postman:shopping` (passes adminPassword and demoPassword from env; never stored here).

item.name: Preview: COD + coupon at Lahore Loom, transfer at Haath Kaari

exec: pm.test('Preview: COD + coupon at Lahore Loom, transfer at Haath Kaari → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('10% off the kurtas, rounded down, max Rs 800', () => pm.expect(a.discount).to.eql(Math.min(Math.floor(kurta * 2 * 10 / 100), 800)));
pm.test('MM- code, one store order per store', () => { pm.expect(d.code).to.match(/^MM-[A-Z2-9]{6}$/); pm.expect(d.storeOrders).to.have.length(2); });
pm.test('group = Σ store orders, to the rupee', () => pm.expect(d.grandTotal).to.eql(d.storeOrders.reduce((n, o) => n + o.total, 0)));
pm.test('each store order adds up', () => d.storeOrders.forEach((o) => pm.expect(o.total).to.eql(o.subtotal - o.discount + o.shippingFee)));
pm.expect({ itemsTotal: d.itemsTotal, discountTotal: d.discountTotal, shippingTotal: d.shippingTotal, grandTotal: d.grandTotal }).to.eql(p);
pm.test('transfer instructions: the store’s own accounts and a deadline', () => { pm.expect(t.payment.accounts.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(t.payment.payBy).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('Checkout replay (same key → same order) → 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
